8月29号，金鹰节开幕，半个电视圈的演员前来参加。

这次金鹰节和往届不太一样，不仅在奥运周期内，同时恰逢中国电视诞生50周年。

所以，这次芒果台花了大力气，开幕式声势浩大。

与此同时，金鹰节官网释放了金鹰女神的照片。

“哇，魏沐你看看，李晓璐真好看。”

片场休息棚，刘施施一袭广袖流仙裙，欢快的拿着手机吃瓜。

“不好看。”

“哪里不好看了，人家这裙子金灿灿的，多好看呀。”

这可是金鹰女神，她想当还没机会呢。

魏沐拿着手机浏览几下，指着嫂子路的妆容：“眼线画的太浓。还有这个衣服，你没发现像个移动的圆形蛋糕吗？”

嫂子路这段造型，裙摆绝对是核心雷点。

层层叠叠的纱裙像被强行塞了十层棉花，蓬松到毫无腰线。

原本不算高挑的李小璐穿上后，直接变成“五五分”身材，远看像个移动的圆形蛋糕。

“哈哈哈^_^.....”

这句话把刘施施逗乐，她本来笑点就低，随便一句话就变成刘哈哈。

很快她就笑不出来。

“说实话，还没上一届好看。”

单说造型，上一届比这一届还丑，全靠颜值撑着。

上一届？

瞎姐眨了眨眼睛，吃味的看着对方。

“原来你喜欢刘一菲那个调调？”

坏了，光顾着吐槽，忘了瞎姐还有个‘小刘一菲’的称号。

“没有，我只是单纯的评价造型。”

“呵呵，我不信。”

她双眼微微眯起，莫名有些吃醋。

倒不是她喜欢吃醋，而是她对刘一菲这个名字比较敏感。

最近两月，唐人版本《射雕英雄传》正在热播，刘施施凭借穆念慈这个角色获得了不少关注。

然后幺蛾子就来了，不知道老蔡咋想的，非要营销“刘施施是刘一菲表妹”。

“我上网查过，我比她大5个月，当她表妹？真不知道K姐怎么想的！！”

没有人喜欢成为谁的替代品，瞎姐一直对这件事耿耿于怀。

“没事，你放心，我去跟老蔡说，让她撤了这个传闻。”

“真哒？”

“嗯。”

不管从哪个方面来说，营销“小刘一菲”都是一招臭棋。

蔡怡农那个女人就是个臭棋篓子，买水军黑人有一套，营销是真不行。

就像后世，两家粉丝撕逼，人家刘一菲粉丝就喜欢拿着这点反击。

On August 29, the Golden Eagle Festival opened, and actors from half the television industry came to participate.

This Golden Eagle Festival is different from previous ones. Not only does it fall within the Olympic cycle, it also coincides with the 50th anniversary of the birth of Chinese television.

Therefore, Mango Channel spent a lot of effort this time, and the opening ceremony was grand.

At the same time, the official website of the Golden Eagle Festival released photos of the Golden Eagle Goddess.

"Wow, Wei Mu, look at Li Xiaolu, she's so pretty."

In the rest room of the studio, Liu Shishi wore a fairy dress with wide sleeves and happily ate melon with her mobile phone.

"It doesn't look good."

"What's wrong with it? This dress is so golden. It's so pretty."

This is the Golden Eagle Goddess, she doesn't think she has a chance yet.

Wei Mu browsed a few times on his phone and pointed at sister-in-law Lu's makeup: "The eyeliner is too thick. And this dress, don't you notice it looks like a moving round cake?"

In this look of sister-in-law, the skirt is definitely the key point.

The layered gauze skirt seemed to have been forcibly stuffed with ten layers of cotton, making it so fluffy that there was no waistline.

Li Xiaolu, who was not originally tall, transformed into a "50-50" figure after wearing it. From a distance, she looked like a moving round cake.

"Hahaha^_^...."

This sentence made Liu Shishi laugh. She originally had a low point of laughter, but she turned into Liu Haha with just one sentence.

Soon she stopped laughing.

"To be honest, it's not as good as the last one."

In terms of appearance alone, the last one was uglier than this one, and it was all supported by good looks.

Last time?

The blind sister blinked her eyes and looked at the other party in amusement.

"So you like Liu Yifei's tone?"

Too bad, I was so busy complaining that I forgot that Blind Sister is also known as ‘Little Liu Yifei’.

"No, I'm just commenting on the style."

"Haha, I don't believe it."

Her eyes narrowed slightly, feeling a little jealous for no reason.

It's not that she likes to be jealous, but that she is sensitive to the name Liu Yifei.

In the past two months, the Tang Dynasty version of "The Legend of the Condor Heroes" has been on the air, and Liu Shishi has gained a lot of attention for his role as Mu Nianci.

Then the trick came. I don't know what Lao Cai was thinking, insisting on marketing "Liu Shishi is Liu Yifei's cousin".

"I checked online and found out that I am 5 months older than her, so I am her cousin? I really don’t know what Sister K thinks!!"

No one likes to be someone's substitute, and Blind Sister has always been worried about this matter.

"It's okay, don't worry, I'll tell Lao Cai and ask her to withdraw this rumor."

"Really?"

"Yeah."

No matter from which aspect, marketing "Xiao Liu Yifei" is a bad move.

That woman Cai Yinong is just a bad chess bag. Black people have a way of buying money from the navy. She is really bad at marketing.

Just like in later generations, fans of the two families are at odds with each other, and fans of Liu Yifei like to use this to fight back.
